hospital-2.text: Under one second to retrieve a medical image on Everest's platform, compared with general public clouds.

hospital-3.text: Everest built its medical imaging cloud on Equinix. The connection is private, close to the hospitals, and always on.

research-1.text: In Sydney, researchers compare one child's cancer with cases studied on the other side of the world.

research-2.text: Children's Cancer Institute shares and analyses genomic data with research partners around the world.

research-3.text: The science is theirs. Equinix provides the private, well-connected place their data lives and travels from.

learning-1.text: A student walks into a data center for the first time and asks how it all works.

learning-2.text: Nearly two thousand students reached in the two-year Pathways to Tech pilot.

learning-3.text: Kayla's tour became an internship, then a full-time technician role in Chicago.

homes-1.text: In Minooka, Illinois, a public bike path runs along the data center site, and land is being donated for a future fire station.

homes-2.text: More than ninety-five million dollars spent with small and inclusive U.S. businesses in 2025.

homes-3.text: Five promises to the places we call home, reported against every year.

aquatic-1.text: Early swimmers in Saint-Denis are in water warmed, in part, by heat that once left a data center unused.

aquatic-2.text: More than a thousand homes expected to be warmed by heat exported from Equinix P A ten.

aquatic-3.text: Here the thread is warm, not digital: heat leaving a data center and arriving as warm water in a public pool.

datacenter-1.text: Every customer workload and every community connection depends on a hall like this, run carefully every hour of every day.

datacenter-2.text: A P U E of one point three seven, averaged across the year 2025.

datacenter-3.text: A data center is part of its community, not apart from it. Every thread on the model begins here.

tour-datacenter.text: Private connections for care and research. Heat recovered for neighbours. People who keep it running, and who volunteer down the road.

hospital-1.text: A radiologist opens a patient's scan. Somewhere, a family is waiting for what it shows.
